resources.name: JSON Lines

resources.name: JSON Text Sequence

resources.name: MessagePack (⭐7.5k)

resources.name: JSON-RPC

resources.name: MCP

resources.name: MQTT

resources.name: OpenMessaging (⭐287)

resources.name: Server-Sent Events

resources.name: STOMP

resources.name: WebSocket

resources.name: FHIR
